conversations.title: A dry spell reduced flowering and expected yield this season

messages.text: What has been difficult recently?
There was a drought this year and the coffee plants lost flowers.
When did it start and what have you tried?
It started two months ago; I have not tried anything yet.
A dry spell reduced flowering and expected yield this season.
Yes, that's right.

messages.text: Qu'est-ce qui a été difficile ces derniers temps ?

Oui, c'est exact.
